author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonathan Isaac clears waivers
desc: Jonathan Isaac has cleared waivers and is now an unrestricted free agent.
impact: Isaac was waived by the Magic last week. He'll be free to sign with any team as he seeks a fresh start.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Norman Powell unlikely to return to Heat
desc: The expectation across the league is that Norman Powell won't return to the Heat.
impact: Miami is unlikely to be able to afford Powell following the trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo. The Chicago Bulls are among the teams expected to pursue Powell.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jalen Wilson to become unrestricted free agent
desc: The Brooklyn Nets declined to tender a qualifying offer to Jalen Wilson.
impact: Wilson will become an unrestricted free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ochai Agbaji to become unrestricted free agent
desc: The Brooklyn Nets declined to tender a qualifying offer to Ochai Agbaji.
impact: Agbaji averaged 6.7 points in 20 games after being traded to Brooklyn. He will be an unrestricted free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Amari Williams re-signs with Celtics on two-way deal
desc: Amari Williams is returning to the Boston Celtics on a two-way contract.
impact: Williams previously had his team option declined by Boston. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jamir Watkins has team option declined by Wizards
desc: The Washington Wizards decline their team option for Jamir Watkins.
impact: The Wizards did tender a qualifying offer to Watkins. He'll now be a restricted free agent this offseason.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Killian Hayes has team option declined by Kings
desc: The Sacramento Kings declined their team option for Killian Hayes.
impact: Hayes will now be an unrestricted free agent this offseason. He will likely remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: David Jones Garcia to become restricted free agent
desc: The San Antonio Spurs tendered a two-way qualifying offer to David Jones Garcia.
impact: Garcia will become a restricted free agent this offseason.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Harrison Ingram to become restricted free agent
desc: The San Antonio Spurs tendered a two-way qualifying offer to Harrison Ingram.
impact: Ingram will become a restricted free agent this offseason.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brooks Barnhizer to become restricted free agent
desc: The Oklahoma City Thunder have tendered a two-way qualifying offer to Brooks Barnhizer.
impact: Barnhizer will be a restricted free agent this offseason.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jalen Duren drawing interest from Lakers
desc: Jalen Duren has a call scheduled with the Lakers on Tuesday to discuss potential sign-and-trade scenarios.
impact: Duren is also meeting with the Sacramento Kings on Tuesday, as the big man and the Pistons are reportedly far apart on a contract. The 22-year-old is coming off an All-NBA season in which he averaged 19.5 points and 10.5 rebounds per game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Domantas Sabonis linked to Pistons
desc: Domantas Sabonis has been linked to the Pistons in a potential sign-and-trade.
impact: Jalen Duren is slated to meet with the Kings on Tuesday. If he is indeed moved to Sacramento in a sign-and-trade, Sabonis is expected to be on the move back to Detroit.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Harrison Barnes intends to sign 1-year deal with Spurs
desc: Harrison Barnes intends to sign a 1-year, $8 million deal to return to the San Antonio Spurs for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Barnes will now be entering his third season with the Spurs after averaging 9.9 points last season. The veteran has been as reliable as they come during his time in San Antonio, missing just five games across the two seasons. He could transition to a bench role as the Spurs' young corps continues to grow.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Kristaps Porzingis signs 2-year extension with Warriors
desc: Kristaps Porzingis has agreed to a 2-year, $40 million contract extension with the Golden State Warriors.
impact: Porzingis is now under contract with Golden State through the 2027-28 season with a player option in the second season. The veteran played in just 15 games after being traded to the Warriors last season, averaging 16.1 points and 5.3 rebounds with the team. His future role is still very much in question, as Golden State is currently at the center of many offseason rumors.
